_comment: Recorded incidents for the scorer-identity monitor (src/renquant_orchestrator/scorer_identity_monitor.py). Each entry explains EXACTLY one run-over-run boundary: lane key + both run ids (exact) + both stamped digests (prefix-bound, >= 16 hex). It exists for transitions that no promotion receipt, rollback marker, or link-intact ledger append can ever legitimize — a human diagnosed them and the durable record is the memory/progress doc named in `evidence`. Adding an entry is a reviewed change to this repository; an entry never generalizes (no wildcard fields are accepted by the loader).

incidents.reason: 2026-08-31 07:17:50 PDT live-tree `git pull` reset the git-tracked momentum ledger to its committed 1-row (2026-08-02) revision, wiping the 08-08/15/22/29 refit rows (5-row file a1149c -> 1-row file 9aa2d8c; mtime 07:17:50 vs reflog 07:17:54). A truncation is a same-path replacement, not an append, so the ledger self-legitimization can never explain it. The four lost rows carry input digests and are NOT reconstructed; the Saturday refit appends from the surviving tail row.
